answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer posts a work sample plus a 50 POA bond; 5 auditors stake 10 POA each on the verdict. A fake loses its bond, burned; honest auditors split 20 POA, liars lose their stakes. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA burned for nothing, so the attack dies at its nadir. Honest agents pay one bond, pass five checks, and are refunded, like a willow bending yet rooted on basalt.
